ate a build from the Editor Create and manage build profiles Introduction to build profiles A build profile is a set of configuration settings you can use to build your application on a particular platform. Use the Build Profiles window to create multiple build profiles for each platform you work on, saving different configurations for release and development builds. For more information on release and development builds, refer to Introduction to building . Navigate to File > Build Profiles to access the Build Profiles window. Profile types There are two types of profiles available in the Build Profiles window. Platforms The Platforms pane displays a list of currently installed platforms that Unity supports.
